reviews.title: Not dependable
reviews.text: Buyer beware. It worked for me most of the time but not all the time. I was not able to get a refund for the annual fee even after the app proved itself not 100% dependable. I have used many call recorders over the years for coaching sessions. The recordings are part of the service I offer. When it didn’t work randomly for no apparent reason I had to do the session without recording, leaving my customer without the promised recording. I then had to choose a new service because if I can’t count on the app I can’t use it anymore. However I have been unable to get a refund for the amount I paid. I used it for about a month before I found it was not dependable.

reviews.title: Charging money without subscription
reviews.text: There were calls at the time that I felt needed to be recorded, unfortunately I didn’t know that I could do it through my IPhone. This app has been taking money from me since 06/2025 even though I only signed up for the free use without a Subscription. The app was downloaded sometime in the U.S. summer maybe like 05/2025 and deleted after the first payment that was taken without a subscription. It has been taking money unnecessarily and it has caused me severe problems to where I can’t even download other apps. Money has been taken from me unknowingly, but yet it’s still saying that I owe them. Mind you, I Never subscribed and even deleted the app after the free subscription. Your best bet is to tap “recording button” on your iPhone than to deal with this app. Unfortunately, I had to speak with an Apple Representative to understand what was going on with my account. This app has put me under subscription and I DID NOT subscribe, and taking money monthly, on top of that they don’t have a way for you to contact anyone for your issue. I wouldn’t download this app at all. Trust me, I’m learning the hard way!

reviews.title: Does not work they rob you
reviews.text: It said free trial. Downloaded it and tried calling my other phone to see how it works. It literally tells the person you’re recording them and on your end you didn’t even hear it. And there’s so many steps once a person answers you have to do that does not even match up with the practice model. Not even 30 min after downloaded app, I tried canceling. They refuse to give me my $106 after tax back. No one even responded. No human to call. Twice I submitted with Apple and no one made them pay me back. I paid $106 to not even be able to use it. Not even once. Honestly, I don’t even think it’s legal what they did. I will continue to fight this.
